properties.label: Recordings page: [CONTEXT_PATH]/blackbox/  ·  Admins can always upload, view and delete.

properties.name: uploadPermission
properties.label: Who can upload
properties.description: Empty = any logged-in user.

properties.name: viewPermission
properties.label: Who can view all recordings
properties.description: Empty = admins only.

properties.name: deletePermission
properties.label: Who can delete any recording
properties.description: Empty = admins only. Applies to the recordings they can view.

properties.name: ownerAccess
properties.label: Uploaders can view and delete their own recordings

properties.name: maxSizeMb
properties.label: Max file size (MB)
properties.description: Applies to the video and to session.json separately.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.label: Server data: what the server records while a recording runs (the extension tags the recorded tab's requests), kept with the recording.

properties.name: captureServerData
properties.label: Capture server data during recordings
properties.description: The recorded tab's Joget log lines, a System Info snapshot (the Info tab) and, by the settings below, server load, Glowroot traces and Glowroot data. Also exports the apps when the recording stops (without it, at upload).

properties.name: serverDataPermission
properties.label: Who can view server data
properties.description: Empty = admins only. They must also be able to view the recording. Server data: system logs, traces, server load, Glowroot data, Info (license key, system properties) and the exported apps. Also decides who may capture all server log lines and import a ZIP's server data.

properties.name: ownServerData
properties.label: Uploaders can view the server data of their own recordings
properties.description: System logs, traces, server load, System Info (license key, system properties) and the exported apps. It never lets them export apps: see "Who can export apps they don't administer". No = only the users above.

properties.name: systemLogMaxMb
properties.label: Max size of system logs per node per recording (MB)
properties.description: Each server node keeps up to this much of a recording's log lines; lines after this are dropped and the viewer says the log was cut off.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.name: serverDataKeepDays
properties.label: Delete server data not uploaded after (days)
properties.description: Captured server data (log lines, server load, traces, Info, app exports) waits on the server until the recording is uploaded.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of days.

properties.name: captureGauges
properties.label: Sample server load during recordings
properties.description: Needs "Capture server data during recordings". Every second: heap, GC time, CPU, busy request threads and database connections, shown as the Server load strip.

properties.name: captureTraces
properties.label: Copy Glowroot traces of slow and failed requests
properties.description: Needs "Capture server data during recordings". Glowroot's own slow threshold decides which requests have a trace; it is not changed.

properties.name: captureGlowrootData
properties.label: Copy Glowroot data for the recording
properties.description: Needs "Capture server data during recordings" and Glowroot 0.14 on each node. About a minute after a recording stops, each node cuts the recording out of its Glowroot data, in Glowroot's own format: the traces of the recorded requests, plus the aggregates and gauges of all traffic during the recording. Download it on the replay page and open it in a standalone Glowroot. Each build needs free disk space in Joget's temp folder of about the size of Glowroot's data.h2.db (it is skipped, with the reason, when there is not enough).

properties.name: captureAllServerLogs
properties.label: Also capture all other server log lines during recordings
properties.description: Needs "Capture server data during recordings". Keeps every log line written while a recording runs, not only those of the recorded tab's requests: scheduler jobs, email, background threads and other users' requests (shown greyed, under a filter). Only for recordings started by users allowed by "Who can view server data", since the lines can hold other users' data. Busy servers fill the max size faster.

properties.name: glowrootUrl
properties.label: Glowroot address
properties.description: Empty = the Glowroot agent of this Joget (found from its admin.json, usually http://localhost:4000). Read as Glowroot's anonymous user.

properties.label: Support data: what a support engineer needs besides the recording. Shown only to users who may view server data.

properties.name: recentChangesDays
properties.label: Recent changes period (days)
properties.description: Needs "Capture server data during recordings". The Info tab's first section lists the app versions and wflow files changed in this period (the app versions narrowed to the apps the recording used and apps sharing their tables). Taken at recording start, with the System Info snapshot. At most 365.

properties.name: includeAppExport
properties.label: Export the apps used in the recording
properties.description: When the recording stops (at upload when server data was not captured or that export failed), the apps found in the recorded tab's URLs (apps with problems first, then the most used; App Center only when it had problems or was the only app) are exported with Joget's own app export (.jwa, without form data, plugins or groups) and kept with the recording. App definitions can hold plugin settings and environment variables.

properties.name: maxApps
properties.label: Most apps to export
properties.description: Per recording. Each app adds an export, sample data and work for the server at upload. 0 = no limit.

properties.name: appExportPermission
properties.label: Who can export apps they don't administer
properties.description: Empty = nobody: only admins and each app's own admins get an app (its definition and sample form data) exported. Users chosen here get only the apps Joget lets them access (one of the app's userviews allows them); other apps are listed as not exported.

properties.name: sampleData
properties.label: Allow capturing form data
properties.description: Added to each .jwa like Joget's own export with data, so importing it imports them: the records the recording opened or saved, rows of the app's other tables that point at them, and the newest rows of tables with none. Values are masked: same length, letters, digits and symbols, but fake (options, yes/no and small numbers kept). Uploaded files become placeholders. Only in apps the uploader may have exported (admins, the app's own admins, "Who can export apps they don't administer"). They can untick "Mask data" in the extension's popup to keep real values; columns matching the always-masked names stay masked.

properties.name: sampleRows
properties.label: Newest rows per table when the recording touched none

properties.name: sampleKeepIds
properties.label: Record ids in sample data
properties.description: New ids (default): every record gets a new unique id, also where other rows point at it, so importing never overwrites existing rows; the App tab lists old and new ids. Keep the original ids only for a server where overwriting is fine.

properties.name: sensitiveColumns
properties.label: Always-masked column names
properties.description: Comma-separated words. A column whose name has one as a word (ic_no, homeAddress, email-2) is always masked, also with real values.
properties.value: password, ic, nric, passport, email, phone, mobile, tel, address, salary, birth, dob, bank, account, card, iban, ssn
